# Configuration

`DatadogApmConfig` holds every setting of a client. It is **immutable** after construction,
validated when it is built (invalid values raise a `CONFIG` error) and its string/debug form
**redacts every credential**. The settings of Datadog APM itself (endpoint, credentials and other
service fields) are listed under [Service settings](#service-settings); the settings every Grow
Codes SDK shares follow under [Common settings](#common-settings).

## Service settings

<!-- @sdk-kit:keep service-settings — service-owned: endpoint, credentials, service fields; kept by "sdk-kit sync" -->

| Setting | Default | Environment variables (precedence order) |
| - | - | - |
| `url` — Agent trace intake (`/info` for `health`, `ping`, `serverVersion`) | `http://127.0.0.1:8126` | `GROW_DATADOG_APM_URL`, `DD_TRACE_AGENT_URL`, `http://${DD_AGENT_HOST}:${DD_TRACE_AGENT_PORT}` |
| `otlpEndpoint` — Agent OTLP receiver | host of `url` + `:4318` (HTTP, `/v1/traces` appended) / `:4317` (gRPC) | `GROW_DATADOG_APM_OTLP_HTTP_ENDPOINT` / `GROW_DATADOG_APM_OTLP_GRPC_ENDPOINT` (by protocol), `GROW_DATADOG_APM_OTLP_ENDPOINT`, `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT`, `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT` |
| `protocol` — OTLP protocol | `http/protobuf` | `GROW_DATADOG_APM_OTLP_PROTOCOL`, `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_PROTOCOL`, `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL` |
| `serviceName` — Datadog `service` | none (required by `initTracing`) | `GROW_DATADOG_APM_SERVICE`, `DD_SERVICE`, `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME` |
| `serviceVersion` — Datadog `version` | none | `GROW_DATADOG_APM_VERSION`, `DD_VERSION` |
| `environment` — Datadog `env` | none | `GROW_DATADOG_APM_ENV`, `DD_ENV` |
| `tags` — extra resource attributes (`key:value`, comma or space separated) | none | `GROW_DATADOG_APM_TAGS`, `DD_TAGS` |
| `apiKey` — API key, query API only (secret) | none | `GROW_DATADOG_APM_API_KEY`, `DD_API_KEY` |
| `appKey` — application key with `apm_read`, query API only (secret) | none | `GROW_DATADOG_APM_APP_KEY`, `DD_APP_KEY`, `DD_APPLICATION_KEY` |
| `site` — Datadog site | `datadoghq.com` | `GROW_DATADOG_APM_SITE`, `DD_SITE` |
| `apiUrl` — query API base URL | `https://api.<site>` | `GROW_DATADOG_APM_API_URL` |

The Agent needs no credentials (it holds `DD_API_KEY` itself); `apiKey` and `appKey` are needed
only by `DatadogSpansQuery` and are always redacted. More on each function is on the
[Functions](functions.md) page.

<!-- @sdk-kit:endkeep -->

## Common settings

| Setting | Default | Environment variable |
| - | - | - |
| `connectTimeout` — connection setup | 10 s | `GROW_DATADOG_APM_CONNECT_TIMEOUT` |
| `requestTimeout` — per attempt (headers + body) | 30 s | `GROW_DATADOG_APM_REQUEST_TIMEOUT` |
| `totalTimeout` — whole call incl. retries and backoff | 120 s | `GROW_DATADOG_APM_TOTAL_TIMEOUT` |
| `retry` — retry policy (below) | 3 retries | `GROW_DATADOG_APM_MAX_RETRIES` |
| `tls.caCertPath` / `tls.caCertPem` — extra CA | none | `GROW_DATADOG_APM_CA_CERT` (path) |
| `tls.clientCertPath` + `tls.clientKeyPath` — mutual TLS | none | `GROW_DATADOG_APM_CLIENT_CERT`, `GROW_DATADOG_APM_CLIENT_KEY` |
| `tls.insecureSkipVerify` — tests only, logs a warning once | `false` | `GROW_DATADOG_APM_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY` |
| `proxy` — proxy URL | none (environment proxies are **ignored**) | `GROW_DATADOG_APM_PROXY` |
| `headers` — extra request headers | `{}` | — |
| `userAgentSuffix` — appended to the User-Agent | none | — |
| `hooks` — request/response callbacks ([Hooks](hooks.md)) | none | — |
| `logger` — diagnostic logger ([Hooks](hooks.md)) | silent | — |

Every request sends `User-Agent: grow-codes-datadog-apm/<version> (<language>)`.

## From the environment

`fromEnv` resolves each setting with this precedence:

1. the value passed in code (overrides),
2. `GROW_DATADOG_APM_<NAME>`,
3. the vendor variables of Datadog APM (see [Functions](functions.md)), in their documented order,
4. the default.

Parsing rules:

- **Durations** accept integer milliseconds (`1500`) or Go-style units: `500ms`, `10s`, `2m`, `1h`,
  combinations such as `1m30s`.
- **Booleans** accept `true/false`, `1/0`, `yes/no`, `on/off` (any case).
- An **empty** variable counts as unset.
- A present but **invalid** value raises a `CONFIG` error that names the variable, never its value.

=== "TypeScript"

    ```ts
    import { DatadogApmClient, DatadogApmConfig } from "@grow-codes/datadog-apm";

    // Environment only
    const client = DatadogApmClient.fromEnv();

    // Environment with explicit overrides (explicit values win)
    const config = DatadogApmConfig.fromEnv({ requestTimeoutMs: 5_000 });

    // Everything in code
    const explicit = new DatadogApmConfig({
      url: "http://datadog-agent.internal:8126",
      serviceName: "checkout",
      environment: "prod",
      apiKey: process.env.DD_API_KEY,
      appKey: process.env.DD_APP_KEY,
      site: "datadoghq.eu",
      connectTimeoutMs: 5_000,
      requestTimeoutMs: 15_000,
      totalTimeoutMs: 60_000,
      retry: { maxRetries: 5, initialBackoffMs: 200 },
      tls: { caCertPath: "/etc/ssl/internal-ca.pem" },
      proxy: "http://proxy.internal:3128",
      headers: { "x-team": "payments" },
      userAgentSuffix: "my-app/1.4",
    });
    const custom = new DatadogApmClient(explicit);
    console.log(String(explicit)); // apiKey and appKey shown as [REDACTED]
    ```

=== "Rust"

    ```rust
    use std::time::Duration;
    use grow_datadog_apm::{DatadogApmClient, DatadogApmConfig, RetryPolicy};

    // Environment only
    let client = DatadogApmClient::from_env()?;

    // Environment with explicit overrides (explicit values win)
    let config = DatadogApmConfig::builder()
        .request_timeout(Duration::from_secs(5))
        .build_from_env()?;

    // Everything in code
    let explicit = DatadogApmConfig::builder()
        .url("http://datadog-agent.internal:8126")
        .service_name("checkout")
        .environment("prod")
        .api_key(std::env::var("DD_API_KEY").unwrap_or_default())
        .app_key(std::env::var("DD_APP_KEY").unwrap_or_default())
        .site("datadoghq.eu")
        .connect_timeout(Duration::from_secs(5))
        .request_timeout(Duration::from_secs(15))
        .total_timeout(Duration::from_secs(60))
        .retry(RetryPolicy::default().with_max_retries(5))
        .ca_cert_path("/etc/ssl/internal-ca.pem")
        .proxy("http://proxy.internal:3128")
        .header("x-team", "payments")
        .user_agent_suffix("my-app/1.4")
        .build()?;
    let custom = DatadogApmClient::new(explicit)?;
    println!("{:?}", custom.config()); // api_key and app_key shown as [REDACTED]
    ```

=== "Go"

    ```go
    // Environment only
    client, err := datadogapm.NewClientFromEnv()

    // Everything in code: zero values mean "use the default"
    cfg := datadogapm.Config{
        CommonConfig: datadogapm.CommonConfig{
            URL:             "http://datadog-agent.internal:8126",
            ConnectTimeout:  5 * time.Second,
            RequestTimeout:  15 * time.Second,
            TotalTimeout:    time.Minute,
            Retry:           &datadogapm.RetryPolicy{MaxRetries: 5, InitialBackoff: 200 * time.Millisecond},
            TLS:             datadogapm.TLSConfig{CACertPath: "/etc/ssl/internal-ca.pem"},
            Proxy:           "http://proxy.internal:3128",
            Headers:         map[string]string{"x-team": "payments"},
            UserAgentSuffix: "my-app/1.4",
        },
        ServiceName: "checkout",
        Environment: "prod",
        APIKey:      datadogapm.NewSecret(os.Getenv("DD_API_KEY")),
        AppKey:      datadogapm.NewSecret(os.Getenv("DD_APP_KEY")),
        Site:        "datadoghq.eu",
    }
    if err := cfg.Validate(); err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err) // errors.Is(err, datadogapm.ErrConfig)
    }
    custom, err := datadogapm.NewClient(cfg)

    // Environment with explicit overrides (explicit values win; nil env = process environment)
    merged, err := datadogapm.ConfigFromEnvWith(datadogapm.Config{
        CommonConfig: datadogapm.CommonConfig{RequestTimeout: 5 * time.Second},
    }, nil)
    fmt.Println(merged) // APIKey and AppKey shown as [REDACTED]
    ```

## Retry policy

| Field | Default | Meaning |
| - | - | - |
| `maxRetries` | 3 | retries after the first attempt (so up to 4 attempts) |
| `initialBackoff` | 100 ms | backoff cap of the first retry |
| `maxBackoff` | 10 s | cap of every backoff |
| `multiplier` | 2 | growth of the cap per retry |
| `maxRetryAfter` | 60 s | longest server-requested `Retry-After` the client waits for |

Backoff for retry *n* (0-based) is **full jitter**: a random wait between 0 and
`min(maxBackoff, initialBackoff × multiplier^n)`.

Requests are retried on HTTP 429, 408, 502, 503, 504 and on network errors. **Idempotent**
requests (`GET HEAD OPTIONS PUT DELETE`, or marked idempotent) are also retried on HTTP 500.
Other requests (for example `POST`) are retried only on 429 and on connection errors that happened
before the request was sent, never after an uncertain send.

On 429 and 503 the client honours `Retry-After` (seconds or HTTP date) and waits
`max(retryAfter, backoff)`. When that wait exceeds `maxRetryAfter` or the remaining
`totalTimeout`, it stops at once with `RATE_LIMITED`/`UNAVAILABLE` and sets `retryAfter` on the
error. Set `maxRetries` to 0 to turn retries off.

## Timeouts and cancellation

- `connectTimeout` bounds connection setup, `requestTimeout` each attempt, `totalTimeout` the whole
  call including backoff sleeps. An exhausted timeout raises `TIMEOUT`.
- Cancellation is honoured during requests and backoff sleeps and raises `CANCELLED`:
  TypeScript `{ signal }` (`AbortSignal`), Rust dropping the future, Go `ctx`, Python `cancel=`
  (`CancelToken`) or task cancellation, Java `…Async` futures (`cancel(true)`).

## TLS and proxies

- Add a private CA with `tls.caCertPath` (or the PEM text in `tls.caCertPem`).
- Mutual TLS needs `tls.clientCertPath` and `tls.clientKeyPath` together.
- `tls.insecureSkipVerify` disables certificate checks. Use it for local tests only; the client
  logs a warning once.
- `HTTP_PROXY`/`HTTPS_PROXY` are **ignored** so that credentials never leave through an unexpected
  proxy. Set `proxy` (or `GROW_DATADOG_APM_PROXY`) to use one.
